post.text:
This is the interview Donald Trump didn’t want you to see.

His FCC refused to air my interview with Stephen Colbert.

Trump is worried we’re about to flip Texas. https://t.co/BCev5jZbKc
post.author_description: Texas State Representative, former middle school teacher, and Presbyterian seminarian running for the U.S. Senate to take power back for working people.

description.description: These frames show a man entering a talk show stage. In frame 1, he walks out in front of a blue and white brick wall backdrop while smiling. In frame 2, he is seen walking across the set toward the desk, where host Stephen Colbert follows him. In frame 3, the guest appears to be adjusting his jacket or shirt while bowing slightly near the seating area. In frame 4, the guest is seated on a blue sofa while Stephen Colbert sits at his desk, both looking toward the camera.
